title: The Never Ending Interview – episode (16:9)

captions.note: subtitles_16x9 optional, off by default (references without burnt-in subtitles)

music.note: MVP without music bed (T14, decided 2026-11-08): the template ships no music; a music bed needs its source and rights documented in sources.json (asset provenance) and is ducked by audio_master

logo_sting.role: after the cold open, followed by a chevron wipe

format_card.role: explainer (title + up to 3 sentences, ~6 s) and transition ("Our starting question comes from none other than…", ~3 s)

band_card.role: starter card and one card at the first appearance of every link, revealed and left by chevron wipes

chevron_wipe.role: transition after the sting, into and out of every band card, into the logo end

cliffhanger_card.role: after the last link: the open question goes to the next band

loud_sounds.role: outro sound montage before the logo end

endcard.role: last picture, YouTube end screen zone free

thumbnail.role: YouTube thumbnail: frame chosen by the editor, headline = the question or a "WHO IS NEXT?"-like claim

hook.note: cold open: the strongest/funniest answer, ~9 s, no cards

chapters.note: one chapter per link (band card) for the YouTube description; chapters.json overrides the derived titles

done.note: "captions-text" counts as done when the project has no captions (status not-required); outside the duration frame the duration-exception review is needed as well

chain.note: reconstruct the chain from transcripts only (nei-chain.mjs), every link with source and timecode

rules: Only the NEI segment of a festival interview belongs into the recipe (not "Who Follows Who" or shout-outs).
Chain from transcripts only: the question of link n is answered in link n+1; report breaks, never invent questions.
Shorten answers to the punchline; keep question and hand-over complete.
Band card at the first appearance of every link; names spelled as in the transcript, uncertain spellings flagged.
Cold open: strongest answer (~9 s), reason the choice in the review report.
No transitions other than chevron wipe and glitch flash.
Brand layer only within the brand.json limits; episode-layer elements as free extensions.
